name: Close Check
office_task: Each month, check whether a client's Xero file is ready to close and publish Ready or Not ready with the items to fix.
systems_of_record: the ledger (Xero): bank statement lines, draft invoices and bills, the suspense account and tax rates for the month
the practice management system (such as Xero Practice Manager or Karbon): the client's month-end close job and its open steps
the system the report is published into, which issues the report_id

emits.write: one view of the month's close check per audience (practice, client owner): Ready to close or Not ready with the items to fix, each item carrying its definition id, source and as-of time, or published as unavailable with the reason; a correction is a new version superseding the old, with the named person and the reason
emits.readback: reading the month's reports back returns each report_id with its version, published_at and published_by; no id back means it was not published and report.publish_failed is raised

emits.write: an exception naming the definition's owner or the threshold's person: a source that could not be read, an item with no definition or two, a threshold that could not be compared, a correction missing a person or reason, or a view that did not read back
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the month, the item, the reason and the exception_owner
